name: Purple Sweet Potato Smoothie (Purple Frost)
steps: Put 1/2 cup frozen purple sweet potato cubes, 1/2 cup chilled unsweetened plant milk, 1 tablespoon raw almond butter, 1 1/2 soft pitted Medjool dates (at the bottom), 1 tablespoon rolled oats, 1 tablespoon chia and/or hemp seeds, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, a pinch of cloves or nutmeg, 1/2 to 1 cup ice and a pinch of salt in a high-speed blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and add more dates, cinnamon, vanilla or ice if you like.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately, topped with whipped cream and granola if you like.
garnish: optional vegan whipped cream, granola, cinnamon
verified_note: Halved from 2-3 servings. Plant milk mapped to oat_milk, almond butter to nuts, dates to dried_fruit, chia to sabja, vanilla extract to vanilla_syrup, salt to black_salt. Not included: frozen purple sweet potato 0.5cup, rolled oats 1tbsp

name: Kinako Banana Smoothie (Nutty Banana)
steps: Put 240 ml soy milk and 4/5 of a banana in a blender.
Add 80 ml yogurt and about 3/4 tablespoon kinako (plus sesame seeds if you like), then the sweetened black soybeans (kuromame) if using.
Blend for about 5 seconds and serve.
verified_note: Page is 1 serving (1 banana, 100 ml yogurt, 1 tbsp kinako, 300 ml soy milk, optional 100 ml sweetened kuromame) but over 450 ml, so scaled to 0.8 and the optional kuromame left out. No honey on the page.

name: Hojicha Caramel Milkshake (Roasted Caramel)
steps: Whip 1/4 cup heavy cream with 1/2 tablespoon sugar in a tall container with a handheld frother to medium peaks. Set aside.
Blend 2 cups ice, 3/4 cup milk, 1 teaspoon ground hojicha and 2 tablespoons dulce de leche, using the tamper, until the ice is slushy and finely crushed.
Pour into a cup, spoon the whipped cream on top and sift a little ground hojicha over it.
Serve immediately with a straw.

name: Korean Yuzu Yogurt Smoothie (Citrus Yogurt)
steps: Blend yuzu preserve, Greek yogurt, milk, and ice until silky, smooth, and tangy
Serve chilled

name: Sikhye Vanilla Milkshake (Sweet Rice Shake)
steps: Blend sweet Sikhye rice punch with vanilla ice cream and milk
Garnish top with toasted pine nuts
garnish: top with toasted pine nuts 1/2 cup Sikhy

name: Chestnut Caramel Cream Chiller (Rich Autumn)
steps: Blend chestnut puree, milk, and caramel over ice
Spoon thick whipped cream over top layer

name: Korean Black Sesame Frozen Milk (Black Sesame Frost)
steps: Put 1 cup (250 ml) plant milk (the author uses soy), 4 ice cubes, 2 tbsp black sesame seed butter (or 1/4 cup black sesame powder) and 2 tsp liquid sweetener (vegan honey or similar) together.
Combine (blend) everything until smooth and drink right away.
verified_note: Version 2 (without ice cream) of the page used. Plant milk mapped to soy_milk (author used soy); vegan honey/liquid sweetener mapped to honey. Page only says 'combine the listed ingredients'; ice cubes are not an ingredient. Version 1 instead blends 3 scoops black sesame ice cream with 1 cup plant milk and 1-2 tbsp black sesame powder.

name: Matcha Azuki Milkshake (Matcha Red Bean)
steps: Blend matcha, ice cream, and milk
Layer sweet red bean paste at bottom of glass and pour shake over

name: Blueberry Yogurt Cheong Smoothie (Berry Yogurt)
steps: Rinse 75 g frozen blueberries under running water two or three times. Set out 2 or 3 ice cubes if you want it colder.
Put the blueberries, 70 ml milk and 1/2 tbsp honey into a blender.
Add 85 ml plain yogurt and the 2 or 3 ice cubes.
Blend for 40 to 50 seconds until finely ground.
Pour into a glass and top with whipped cream, a few blueberries and apple mint.
verified_note: Frozen blueberries mapped to berries (no blueberry id); page uses fresh/frozen fruit plus honey, not blueberry cheong. Whipped cream and apple mint are garnish with no amounts.

name: Korean Strawberry Cream Float (Pink Float)
steps: Make the strawberry syrup (single-serving share: 84 g hulled, chopped strawberries and 44 ml water; easier to make the full batch of 6 1/2 cups strawberries and 2 cups water): simmer the strawberries in the water until soft, about 15 minutes.
Strain and discard the solids.
Add the sugar (41 g per serving), lime juice (about 1/2 tsp) and lemon juice (about 1/4 tsp) plus a tiny pinch of citric acid, and simmer 5 minutes, skimming off any foam.
Cool to room temperature, strain into a lidded container and refrigerate until cold, at least 2 hours.
In a glass, combine 1 part strawberry syrup with 2 to 3 parts cold seltzer, to taste.
Top with a few scoops of vanilla ice cream, add a straw and serve right away.

name: Hojicha Azuki Cream Float (Roasted Bean)
steps: Layer red bean paste at bottom, fill glass with iced hojicha tea, top off with vanilla ice cream

name: Korean Injeolmi Protein Shake (Nutty Fitness)
steps: Heat 1 cup (240 ml) unsweetened plant-based milk in a saucepan with 2 tbsp kinako powder, plus maple syrup or other sweetener to taste if you like.

Keep heating until steaming hot, then pour into a mug.
Drink right away, or chill it and enjoy it cold.

name: Matcha Coconut Gelato Shake (Green Coconut)
steps: Put 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk, 1 large frozen banana, 2 tsp matcha and a few ice cubes (optional) in a blender. If the coconut milk is unsweetened, add 1 to 2 pitted chopped dates or about 1 tsp maple syrup.

garnish: toasted coconut flakes, dark chocolate shavings or cacao nibs
verified_note: Optional sweetener (1-2 dates or ~1 tsp maple syrup) from the notes not included in ings.

name: Korean Sweet Corn Cream Float (Savory Sweet Float)
steps: Mix sweet corn syrup into carbonated soda water over ice, top with vanilla ice cream and toasted corn

name: Korean Peach Yogurt Smoothie (Fruity Yogurt)
steps: Put 1 cup sliced peaches (fresh or frozen), about 2 1/2 tbsp (40 ml) vanilla Greek yogurt, 1/3 cup (80 ml) almond milk and about 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup into a blender. If using fresh peaches, use almond milk frozen in an ice cube tray the night before; if using frozen peaches, use fresh almond milk.
Blend until smooth.
Add any toppings you like and enjoy.

name: Kuromitsu Kinako Gelato Milk (Okinawa Gelato)
steps: Add 2 tbsp kinako and the sweetener (1 tsp sugar, or kuromitsu as the page suggests) to a mug and mix.

Add the remaining 2/3 cup cold milk and mix well.

name: Black Sesame Banana Smoothie (Nutty Sesame)
steps: Peel 1 ripe banana, halve it and put it in the blender.

Add 3 to 4 ice cubes, cover and blend until the banana is fully incorporated.
Pour from the blender into a glass.

name: Matcha Banana Yogurt Smoothie (Green Yogurt)
steps: Put 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup sliced frozen banana, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp ceremonial matcha into a blender.

Taste and add more honey if you want it sweeter.
Serve right away, topped with about 2 tbsp whipped cream if you like.

name: Korean Persimmon Cream Float (Persimmon Float)
steps: Mix persimmon puree into carbonated soda water over ice, float vanilla ice cream on top

name: Hojicha White Chocolate Shake (Roasted Chocolate)
steps: Heat 1 cup whole milk with 1 tbsp hojicha (roasted green tea) leaves in a pan over low heat.
Keep it steaming for 2 to 3 minutes until the milk turns light brown.

Put a few ice cubes in a tall glass and pour the milk over them.
Top with 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and shaved dark chocolate, and serve cold.

name: Korean Green Plum Yogurt Smoothie (Tangy Yogurt)
steps: Blend green plum syrup, Greek yogurt, milk, and ice until velvety and digestive friendly

name: Japanese Concord Grape Cream Float (Grape Float)
steps: Mix purple grape syrup into carbonated soda water over ice, float vanilla ice cream on top

name: Korean Sweet Potato Ice Cream Milkshake (Sweet Potato Shake)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Halve 1 medium sweet potato (one half is one serving) and set it cut side up on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Mix 1/4 tsp vanilla extract with 1/2 tbsp olive oil and brush it over the cut side, then sprinkle with 2 tbsp light brown sugar.
Roast for 45 minutes, until a paring knife slides in easily, then refrigerate until fully cool.

Blend the cooled sweet potato with 3 scoops butter pecan or vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 tbsp cinnamon, a pinch (1/16 tsp) nutmeg, 1/4 tbsp light brown sugar and 2/3 cup (about 150 ml) milk on medium speed until smooth.
Microwave 2 tbsp white chocolate chips with 1/4 tsp coconut oil in 30-second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth. Dip the rim of the glass in it, then roll it in chopped candied pecans.
Pour in the milkshake, leaving about an inch at the top, sprinkle with more chopped candied pecans and pile on mini marshmallows (about 6 tbsp).
Toast the marshmallows with a kitchen torch and serve cold with a long straw and a spoon.
garnish: white chocolate and candied pecan rim, toasted mini marshmallows

name: Kinako Caramel Milkshake (Nutty Caramel)
steps: Blend kinako flour, vanilla ice cream, milk, and caramel syrup until thick and roasty sweet

name: Yuzu Honey Gelato Shake (Citrus Gelato)
steps: Blend yuzu honey jam, vanilla gelato, and milk until smooth, citrusy, and refreshing

name: Korean Apple Cheong Yogurt Smoothie (Apple Yogurt)
steps: Wash 1 apple, cut it into pieces that fit your blender and discard the core.
Put the apple pieces in the blender and top with 2/3 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tsp honey (optional; up to 1 tbsp if you want it sweeter, or none if the apple is sweet) and 1/8 tsp cinnamon (optional).
Blend for about 10 to 15 seconds until completely smooth, then pour into a glass.
verified_note: Greek yogurt mapped to yogurt. Honey and cinnamon are optional on the page.

name: Black Sesame Cream Soda (Sesame Float)
steps: Mix black sesame syrup with carbonated soda water over ice, gently float vanilla ice cream on top

name: Korean Chestnut Milkshake (Chestnut Shake)
steps: Blend sweet chestnut spread, vanilla ice cream, and milk until velvety and nutty sweet

name: Matcha Mango Gelato Layer (Matcha Mango)
steps: Put 1 tsp matcha in a small bowl, add about 2 tbsp (30 ml) water heated to about 80°C (175°F) and whisk vigorously until smooth and lightly frothy.
If you like, add 1 to 2 tsp maple syrup, honey or agave and whisk again.
Fill a tall glass with plenty of ice.
Pour 3 tbsp mango purée over the ice so it settles at the bottom.
Slowly pour 180 ml chilled milk (dairy, oat, soy, almond or coconut) over the mango layer.
Slowly pour the whisked matcha over the milk to make the green top layer.
Stir before drinking; garnish with mint leaves, a matcha dusting or fresh mango cubes if you like.
verified_note: Mango purée mapped to mango_pulp. Sweetener is optional (1-2 tsp maple, honey or agave); lower end used as maple_syrup.

name: Korean Grapefruit Cream Float (Ruby Float)
steps: Mix 1 cup pink grapefruit juice with 1/2 cup seltzer in a cup and set aside.
Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in a separate glass, then pour the grapefruit soda over it.
verified_note: Ice cream scoops as pcs. Page uses no ice.

name: Hojicha Banana Milkshake (Roasted Fruit)
steps: Put 1 ripe banana, 150 ml milk of your choice, 50 ml ice cubes or water, 15 g nuts (about 1 tbsp), 1 tsp hojicha powder with 1/4 tsp each of ground cinnamon, ginger and cardamom (or 1 tsp Hojichai spiced powder) and 2 tsp agave syrup into a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve chilled.
verified_note: Page uses a branded Hojichai (spiced hojicha) powder; its stated alternative (1 tsp hojicha powder + 1/4 tsp each cinnamon, ginger, cardamom) is used. Ground ginger mapped to ginger. water:50 can be ice cubes instead. Nuts unspecified, mapped to nuts.

name: Korean Blue Lemon Cream Float (Ocean Float)
steps: Mix vibrant blue lemon syrup with carbonated soda water over ice, top with vanilla ice cream and cherry

name: Hot Ginger Yuzu Tonic (Winter Warmup)
steps: Simmer ginger slices and cinnamon stick in water for 10 min
Pour hot into mug over yuzu jam; stir well
Soothing for sore throats

name: Iced Shiso Lemon Spritz (Herb Refresher)
steps: Wash 4 to 5 red shiso leaves well, soaking them in water a couple of times.

Put 1 cup (240 ml) water, 0.6 g dried mandarin orange peel, 0.6 g dried licorice root and 1.25 g smashed ginger in a pot (easier to make the full 8-serving batch). Cover, bring to a boil over high heat, then simmer 10 minutes over low heat.
Add the shiso leaves and 2 to 3 tsp sugar (if using). Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover and simmer 7 to 8 minutes over medium-low heat. If using honey or agave instead, add it when serving.
Take off the heat, strain out all the solids and let cool on the counter; the liquid will be dark purplish-red.
Just before serving, stir in about 1/2 tbsp fresh lemon juice; it turns bright magenta.
Serve over ice as a chilled pink lemonade (or warm or hot with lemon slices).

name: Ginseng Red Date Elixir (Hanbang Vitality)
steps: Make the ginseng-jujube paste (one serving's share; easier to make the full batch of 2 fresh ginseng roots/2 oz and 1/2 lb dried jujubes): wash and pat dry about 4.7 g fresh ginseng and 19 g dried jujubes.
Pit the jujubes, cut them into small pieces and put them in a bowl.
Trim the top off the ginseng, cut it into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Grind the ginseng and jujubes in a food processor or strong grinder until they form a sticky lump.
Mix in 2 tsp honey and store in a glass jar (keeps a month in the fridge).
To serve, mix about 1 tbsp of the paste into a cup of hot water, sprinkle with a few pine nuts and serve hot.
verified_note: Time-saving paste method used (the page's traditional decoction method has no ingredient amounts). Divided by 12. Jujubes mapped to dried_fruit; 1/2 cup honey per batch is 2 tsp per serving. Page's serving instruction is about 1 tbsp paste per cup of hot water; water:240 is one cup.

name: Kuromitsu Ginger Warm-up (Okinawa Remedy)
steps: Put about 6 g thinly sliced fresh ginger and 300 ml water in a small pot and bring to a boil.
Keep boiling until the liquid has reduced to about 200 ml.
Add about 8 g brown sugar or kokuto (Okinawan black sugar), stir until dissolved and turn off the heat.
Cover the pot and let it steep for 20 minutes.
Strain into a warmed mug and serve hot.

name: Bamboo Leaf Chiller (Serene Chiller)
steps: Pour cold brew bamboo leaf tea over ice cubes, stir in honey and lemon
Cool, grassy, mineral-rich thirst quencher

name: Chrysanthemum Honey Ice (Floral Ice)
steps: Put 4 to 5 dried chrysanthemum buds in a tea strainer and pour over 1 cup boiling water. Steep 3 to 5 minutes until the tea turns bright yellow.
Ideally let the tea cool down a bit.
Add ice to a glass and drizzle in 2 to 3 tbsp honey.
Pour the chrysanthemum tea over the honey and ice, stir until combined and serve cold.
verified_note: Dried chrysanthemum buds mapped to edible_flower (4-5 buds). Honey 2-3 tbsp; lower end used.

name: Mugwort Ginger Wellness Brew (Herbal Care)
steps: Simmer mugwort leaves and ginger in water for 15 minutes
Strain into mug, sweeten with honey to taste
Herbal digestive tonic
Recipe scaled down to a single glass from a batch.

name: Japanese Burdock Root Chiller (Root Chiller)
steps: For a roasted tea, toast 1 to 2 tsp dried burdock root in a dry pot over medium heat until fragrant (skip this for unroasted tea).
Add 1 cup water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes.
Strain out the root and serve.

name: Citrus Peppermint Shiso Tea (Triple Herb)
steps: Steep fresh mint and shiso leaves with yuzu jam in boiling water for 4 minutes

name: Korean Red Ginseng Honey Sparkler (Energy Sparkler)
steps: Whisk red ginseng extract and honey with 2 tbsp warm water until smooth, pour over ice, top off with carbonated sparkling water

name: Japanese Loquat Leaf Honey Chiller (Herbal Chill)
steps: Rinse and dry medium green loquat leaves, scrape the fuzzy underside with a small knife, remove the large central vein and slice or tear into small pieces (or use about 1 tbsp crushed dried loquat leaves per cup).
Put the leaves in a small pot or teapot with 1 cup fresh water, bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Turn off the heat, cover and steep another 10 minutes.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer.
Serve in a tea cup, or in a tall glass over ice.

name: Korean Bellflower Jujube Warm- up (Throat Care)
steps: Simmer bellflower root and dates in water for 40 minutes
Strain decoction into ceramic mug, sweeten with honey while hot

name: Red Shiso Apple Cider Warm-up (Spiced Warmth)
steps: Heat apple juice, red shiso syrup, and water with cinnamon stick for 5 minutes
Serve hot in thick glass mug

name: Korean Astragalus Jujube Tonic (Vitality Tonic)
steps: Simmer astragalus and jujube dates in water for 45 minutes until reduced

name: Kudzu Root Honey Warm-up (Galgeun)
steps: Simmer kudzu root and ginger in water for 25 minutes
Strain into mug, sweeten with honey while steaming hot

name: Japanese Mulberry Leaf Lemon Chiller (Lemon Mulberry)
steps: Mix cold brew mulberry tea with lemon juice and honey over ice

name: Korean Goji Berry Honey Warm-up (Berry Wellness)
steps: Rinse about 1 1/2 to 2 tbsp dried goji berries (traditionally by pouring boiling water over them and discarding it).
Bring 1 cup water to a boil and pour it over the berries. If using sugar, add it now so it dissolves.
Steep for at least 20 minutes.
Add honey or syrup to taste and pour into a cup with some of the berries.

name: Japanese Salted Ume Ginger Warm-up (Plum Remedy)
steps: Put 1 1/2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp manuka honey, a 1 cm piece of fresh ginger (thinly sliced) and half an umeboshi plum in a mug.
Pour over 250 ml just-boiled water and steep 3 minutes.
Muddle with a small spoon, then sip.

name: Korean Pine Needle Honey Warm- up (Pine Warmth)
steps: Bring 1 cup water to a boil in a kettle or saucepan.
Meanwhile finely chop 2 to 4 tbsp pine needles (positively identify the species first; yew is toxic).
Take the water off the heat and add the needles, or pour the water over them in a teapot.
Steep 15 to 20 minutes.
Strain and serve, with honey, lemon or milk if you like.

name: Jeju Tangerine Blossom Cold Brew Honey Tea
steps: Cold brew tangerine blossoms overnight, strain into glass over crystal ice, sweeten with raw acacia honey, float fresh blossom on top
